CHAPTER 15 · ITEM 05 / 14

Competitive firm and output choice

Profit and loss rectangle利潤與虧損面積

YOUR CHECKBOX · 原始清單項目

Calculate profit or loss as TR − TC = (P − ATC) × Q; identify the profit or loss rectangle on a graph.

01 · UNDERSTAND / 概念解釋

利潤=(P−ATC)q，ATC 要在所選產量讀取。圖中長方形高為價與 ATC 差，闊為 q；價低於 ATC 就是虧損。

Profit=TR−TC=(P−ATC)q, with ATC evaluated at the chosen output. On a graph, the height is P−ATC and the width is q. A negative height means loss.

02 · WORKED EXAMPLE / 一個示範

See it in action.

Example 例：P=12,ATC=9,q=20. Profit=(12−9)×20=60. 每件賺三元、二十件賺六十。

03 · TRY IT / 例題練習

One question. Your turn.

P=7,ATC=10,q=5. Profit? 利潤？

這是複習紀錄；答過一題不代表完全掌握。Saved in this browser.
